questions.question: 1. What do you mean by an array?

answers.a: A container of unique elements of similar types
answers.b: Data structure having linear access time
answers.c: Data structure containing elements located in various locations memory which may or may not be contiguous
answers.d: Data structure containing elements of similar types in contiguous storage

explanations.a: Incorrect. Elements in an array may or may not be unique.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Access time in an array is constant, not linear.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Array always stores its elements in contiguous memory locations.
explanations.d: Correct. An array is a data structure containing elements of similar types stored in contiguous memory locations.

questions.question: 2. If for large inputs, X is a better choice than Y, then:

answers.a: Y is asymptotically more efficient than X
answers.b: X is asymptotically more efficient than Y
answers.c: X and Y are equivalently efficient

explanations.a: Incorrect. Y cannot be more efficient as X is a better choice.
explanations.b: Correct. Since X is asymptotically more efficient than Y, hence X will perform better in case of large inputs.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Since X is getting preferred, hence X and Y cannot be equivalent.
explanations.d: Incorrect. X is asymptotically more efficient than Y is the correct answer.

questions.question: 3. Which is one of the fastest sorting algorithms?

explanations.a: Incorrect. Time complexity of bogo sort is O(n*n!) making it one of the worst sorting algorithm.
explanations.b: Correct. Time complexity of merge sort in O(n log n) which is one of the best.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Time complexity of cocktail sort is O(n^2) which is slower than the fastest one.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Only merge sort is one of the fastest sorting algorithms.

questions.question: 4. Which data structure stores a collection of disjoint sets?

explanations.a: Incorrect. Stack stores data in LIFO order, but does not identifies disjoint sets.
explanations.b: Incorrect. This is not a data structure.
explanations.c: Correct. Union Find, also known as Merge Find, stores the disjoint sets, and is helpful for identifying them.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Heap does not identifies disjoint sets.

questions.question: Which of the following is correct?

answers.a: Graphs cannot have cycles, but trees can
answers.b: Trees cannot have cycles, but graphs can
answers.c: Both trees and graphs can have cycles
answers.d: Neither tree nor graphs can have cycles

explanations.a: Incorrect. Trees cannot have cycles, which distinguishes them from general graphs.
explanations.b: Correct. A tree is a special case of graph with no cycles.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Trees are defined as acyclic connected graphs.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Graphs can have cycles, but trees cannot.
